title: Notvorrat: das Kellerregal
question: Your steer pinned the cellar shelf. The roll assigned the shelf as a technical assembly drawing. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Regalplan (Montagezeichnung)
options.lineage: Furniture assembly drawings and their parts list: the cellar shelf in front elevation, line by line
options.thesis: Your cellar shelf as a technical drawing: one board per food group, planned items drawn as dashed outlines, stocked items drawn solid, numbered callouts tying each item to the parts list.
options.viewport: The full shelf in front elevation: eight boards, water crates on the floor, every item an outlined object filled to its stock level and dashed where missing; one large 'Tage versorgt' figure beside it and the parts list underneath.
options.risk: The drawing must stay legible on a phone; it re-stacks board by board, and the line work has to be built strictly or it reads as clip-art.

raised.raise: State is line form, not hue: solid = stocked, dashed = planned, doubled = bald fällig, struck = abgelaufen. Colour only reinforces.
One accent, held back: the signal orange appears only where an MHD needs attention, so it is never decoration.
Map and list are one space: every callout number on the drawing is the same row in the parts list, and hovering one lights the other.
One fixed scale: an item's drawn fill uses the same Soll ratio everywhere (drawing, list, item page), never re-normalised per view.
Extent is honest: each board's width share follows its share of the household's target, so big groups get big boards.

options.label: Holzregal mit Einmachgläsern
options.lineage: The wooden cellar shelf: Weck jars, orange rubber rings, masking-tape labels in marker
options.thesis: A warm, photographic-feeling shelf of jars and cans with handwritten tape labels; each jar is filled to its stock level and its label carries the MHD.
options.viewport: A lit shelf front at night, jars glowing, tape labels readable, gaps where items are missing.
options.risk: The most familiar rendition of the steer; handwriting and wood texture risk kitsch and slow pages.

options.label: Abfahrtstafel für MHD
options.lineage: Boarding pass plus a live gate board
options.thesis: Batches ranked like departures by MHD; a changed date moves its row in place and stays lit until seen.
options.viewport: A departure board of the next twenty batches by MHD, with stock summary as a pass.
options.case: Holds product clarity for the MHD view, but leaves the cellar shelf the user asked for.
options.risk: Airport chrome in a pantry app.

options.label: Emission-line rail
options.thesis: Everything registered to one rail, state as line height and dash.
options.case: Loses both axes: the household does not see itself in a spectrogram.
options.kept: State as line form, not hue.

options.label: Monochrome product page
options.thesis: Neutral scale, one accent, claim plus proof.
options.case: A marketing form for a tool surface; no cellar.

options.label: Convention catalog
options.thesis: Thumbnail grid keyed to a hall map.
options.case: Fuses partly (map = list) but the aesthetic is foreign to the household.
options.kept: Map and list are one space.

options.label: Star atlas
options.thesis: Magnitudes as ranked dots on a navy chart.

options.label: Acetate tab manual
options.thesis: Tab rail sized by extent, acetate leaves over coloured boards.
options.case: Loses both axes against the shelf.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean inventory dashboard: sidebar, KPI cards, progress bars, and traffic-light expiry badges.
canonCard.viewport: KPI row (Tage versorgt, Artikel, bald fällig), then category progress bars and an expiry table.
